title: Discord bot that echoes user text pings @everyone or whole roles
symptoms: Bot message relaying user input notifies the entire server
Role mentions in quoted text ping every member of the role
Same text sent through a webhook or interaction does not ping
cause: In regular bot messages every mention type, including @everyone, is parsed by default when the bot has the permission to use it. Interactions and webhooks parse only user mentions by default, which hides the problem in testing.
fix: Pass allowed_mentions with an empty parse list on any message that contains text you did not write, and list specific user IDs only when a ping is intended.
apply: await channel.send({ content: userText, allowedMentions: { parse: [] } });
affected: Discord API v10 create message, as of 2026-10
